3 days left: submissions close Thursday at noon PST 🚨

Hi Builders,

Submissions close Thursday, November 12 at 12:00 pm PST (3:00 pm EST, 8:00 pm GMT, Friday 1:30 am IST).

🚨 Upload your video today. Processing can take hours, so get it on YouTube and linked now, even if you keep polishing the rest. You can edit your submission until the deadline, so submit now and refine later.

⚠️ After the deadline, don't touch anything: no commits, no README edits, no swapping your video. Leave everything as-is until the winner announcement.

Can't wait to see what you've built! 🎉

4 days ago

Submission checklist: it's go time! ⏳

Hi Builders,

One week left! Submissions close Thursday, November 12 at 12:00 pm PST. Submit today to still get an early eligibility check.

📋 Checklist

Project meaningfully uses PayPal (sandbox is fine) and AI
Judges can run it: hosted demo URL or run instructions in your repo
Public repo on GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with a README and open source license
Public YouTube video under 3 minutes
Sponsor tools selected on the form if you're going for a sponsor prize
Teammates invited and accepted

Lights, camera, PayPal! Video tips and how judging works 🎬

Hi Builders,

10 days to go! Your video is often the first thing judges see, so make it count.

🎬 Video tips

Under 3 minutes, on YouTube, set to public.
Open with the problem and who it's for, then show PayPal and AI working end to end.
Cut loading screens and setup steps. An AI voiceover is fine.
Upload early. Processing can take hours.

🧑‍⚖️ How judging works

Two weeks to go: get your project checked early 🥇

Hi Builders,

Submissions close Thursday, November 12 at 12:00 pm PST. Submit by Thursday, Nov 5 and our review team will check your project for eligibility early and flag anything to fix. You can keep editing until the deadline.

🏆 How to stand out

Make PayPal and AI impossible to miss. Name both in your description, "Built With" section, and video, and show them working.
Give judges something to run: a hosted demo URL or clear run instructions in your repo.
Hide your API keys. Use environment variables, never commit secrets.

The PayPal build session recording is up
Hi Builders,

The recording of Start Building with PayPal is now on YouTube: https://bit.ly/paypalai26recue

Jo, Marco, and Eddie from PayPal's DevRel team cover the hackathon rules and prizes, the PayPal AI Toolkit, and a full sandbox setup. The chapters are in the video description, so you can jump to what you need.
